contract.primary: Six native HTTP error batches retained in order for next explicit flush
contract.acceptance: 6/6 holdouts and 3/3 anchors in each of five trials; unchanged existing assertions; all project, security, CI and approval gates required for merge
contract.bounds: one production candidate; one Darwin generation and child; no deployment or automatic memory promotion
contract.limitations: No guarantee of durable delivery, exactly-once, bounded buffering or retry backoff; process restart can lose in-memory telemetry

boundary: No full-gate promotion. regressed=true is a fail-closed repository veto, not a newly observed component regression. Zero cost inputs are neutral, not measured savings. Root-only replay is not candidate promotion proof. Rollback restores source bytes, never deletes service memory.
